details:
export name: buyItem
input.itemId: a string with no .maxLength(n) or .maxChars(n)
message: Server action shop.buyItem accepts input with no size limit.
name: unbounded-action-input
suggestion: Bound every string with .maxLength(n) or .maxChars(n), every array with .maxItems(n), and every record with .maxEntries(n), so validation refuses an oversized payload. strict.unboundedInput sets this diagnostic's severity.
